svg.aria-label: Line chart of voltage against time from 0.6 to 3.6 ns. A 1 V pulse launched on line A at 1 ns arrives at its far end 464.8 ps later at 0.389 V. The undriven line B shows 0.105 V at its far end.

g.text: volts at the four ends of the pair
a 1 V, 0.5 ns pulse with 0.2 ns edges enters line A at 1 ns.
it reaches the far end of the 80 mm line 465 ps later at 0.389 V peak, slightly ahead of the ε-eff estimate because
line B, never driven, sees 0.105 V at its far end.
